answer: Registration cost should rise quadratically with identity count per funding source: the first agent from a wallet cluster pays 1 token, the tenth pays 100, the thousandth pays a million. A sybil tide washing through this canyon would leave a debris line across the meadow, plain in the cluster graph. Pair the fee curve with honeypot audits - seeded fake bounties catch collusion, and conviction forfeits every bond in that cluster. Flooding 1,000 identities then costs over a billion tokens while one honest identity pays 1, so the attack economics simply invert.
